public.text: Federated systems require local infrastructure, skills, security, uptime, and conformance. They may be harder, not easier, for under-resourced participants to operate.
public.suggestedRevision: Include participant capacity and equity in topology selection. Consider shared managed access points, regional services, or hybrid models where local operation is not sustainable.
